```{r load data, echo = FALSE}
wendhausen_1518 <- read_csv("data/BONARES_Cropland agroforestry 2015-2018/SIGNAL.ID_7013_DATEN_WH_15_18.csv")
wendhausen_1718 <- read_csv("data/BONARES_Cropland Agroforestry 2017 and 2018/signal.ID_7042_BIOMASSE_17_18_WH_280319.csv")
wendhausen_1920 <- read_csv("data/BONARES_Cropland agroforestry 2019-2020/signal.ID_7069_DATEN_WENDHAUSEN_2019_20.csv")
wendhausen_21 <- read_csv("data/BONARES_Cropland agroforestry 2021/signal.ID_7070_DATEN_WENDHAUSEN_2021.csv")
wendhausen_22 <- read_csv("data/BONARES_Cropland agroforestry 2022/signal.ID_7071_DATEN_WENDHAUSEN_2022.csv")
wendhausen_23 <- read_csv("data/BONARES_Cropland agroforestry 2023/signal.ID_7077_DATEN_WENDHAUSEN_2023_CR.csv")

wendhausen <- list(
  wendhausen_1518 = clean_names(wendhausen_1518), 
  wendhausen_1718 = clean_names(wendhausen_1718), 
  wendhausen_1920 = clean_names(wendhausen_1920), 
  wendhausen_21 = clean_names(wendhausen_21), 
  wendhausen_22 = clean_names(wendhausen_22), 
  wendhausen_23 = clean_names(wendhausen_23))




```

```{r}

# Compare columns across all Wendhausen datasets

all_cols <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(wendhausen, names))))

col_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(wendhausen), function(ds) {
  present <- names(wendhausen[[ds]])
  setNames(
    as.data.frame(t(ifelse(all_cols %in% present, "yes", "no"))),
    all_cols
  ) |> cbind(Dataset = ds, row.names = NULL)
}))

col_table <- col_table[, c("Dataset", setdiff(names(col_table), "Dataset"))]
print(col_table)

```

```{r merge data, echo = FALSE}


# Standardise and merge all wendhausen datasets
merged <- bind_rows(lapply(names(wendhausen), function(ds) {
  df <- wendhausen[[ds]]
  
  # Lowercase all column names
  names(df) <- tolower(names(df))
  
  # Merge lat/latitude → latitude, lon/longitude → longitude
  if ("lat" %in% names(df) && !"latitude" %in% names(df))
    df <- rename(df, latitude = lat)
  if ("lon" %in% names(df) && !"longitude" %in% names(df))
    df <- rename(df, longitude = lon)
  
  
  # Merge ww and wheat 
  ww_cols <- grep("^ww_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  for (col in ww_cols) {
    wheat_col <- sub("^ww_", "wheat_", col)
    if (!wheat_col %in% names(df))
      df <- rename(df, !!wheat_col := !!col)
  }
  
  
  # Drop unwanted columns
  df <- select(df, -any_of(c("decomposition", "litter_dm", "objectid", "lat", "lon")))
  
  # Add origin column
  df$origin <- ds
  df
}))

# Move origin to first column
merged <- select(merged, origin, everything())

```

```{r}

merged_long <- merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(or|wheat|straw|sm|sb)_"),
    names_to  = c("crop", ".value"),
     names_pattern = "^(or|wheat|straw|sm|sb)_(.*)",
    names_transform = list(crop = as.factor)
  )
```

```{r}
summary(merged_long)
```

```{r}
# Colour palette for crops
crop_colors <- c("or" = "#E76F51", "wheat" = "#F4A261", "straw" = "#A8C686",
                 "sm" = "#457B9D", "sb" = "#9B7EBD")

# ── 1. DM per crop ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# exlude sb outlier
merged_long <- merged_long %>%
  filter(!(crop == "sb" & dm > 4e+14))

# DM
ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm)), 
       aes(x = factor(year), y = dm, fill = crop)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ crop, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors) +
  labs(title = "DM by crop and year", x = "Year", y = "DM") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")


ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm)),
       aes(x = factor(year), y = dm, fill = crop)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors) +
  labs(title = "DM by crop and year", x = "Year", y = "DM") +
  theme_minimal()


# DM straw (if column exists)
if ("dm_straw" %in% names(merged_long)) {
  ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm_straw)),
         aes(x = factor(year), y = dm_straw, fill = crop)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ crop, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors) +
    labs(title = "DM straw by crop and year", x = "Year", y = "DM straw") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}


```



```{r}
# ── 2. Which crop was harvested in which year ─────────────────────────────────

merged_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(dm)) %>%
  distinct(crop, year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = crop, fill = crop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors) +
  labs(title = "Crop × year harvest overview", x = "Year", y = "Crop") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")


```

```{r plots for relationships, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Overall
ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm), !is.na(distance_to_tree_strip)),
       aes(x = distance_to_tree_strip, y = dm)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#E76F51") +
  labs(title = "DM vs distance to tree strip", x = "Distance (m)", y = "DM") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2. By crop
ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm), !is.na(distance_to_tree_strip)),
       aes(x = distance_to_tree_strip, y = dm, color = crop, fill = crop)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ crop, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = crop_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors) +
  labs(title = "DM vs distance — by crop", x = "Distance (m)", y = "DM") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme(
  strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

# 3. By crop + orientation
ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm), !is.na(distance_to_tree_strip), !is.na(orientation)),
       aes(x = distance_to_tree_strip, y = dm, color = orientation, fill = orientation)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ crop, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "DM vs distance — by crop + orientation", x = "Distance (m)", y = "DM") +
  theme_minimal()+ 
  theme(
  strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

# 4. By orientation
ggplot(merged_long %>% filter(!is.na(dm), !is.na(distance_to_tree_strip), !is.na(orientation)),
       aes(x = distance_to_tree_strip, y = dm, color = orientation, fill = orientation)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "DM vs distance — by orientation", x = "Distance (m)", y = "DM") +
  theme_minimal()
```
